import os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    # marker position determines diagonal
    n=len(g); left=min(c for r,c,v in marks); right=max(c for r,c,v in marks)
    for r,c,v in marks:
        pass
    # markers in corners: top-left/bottom-right correspond main diag; top-right/bottom-left anti
    colors={}
    for r,c,v in marks:
        anti=(c>left and r<n//2) or (c==left and r>=n//2) # using marker side positions
        # robust based on whether at right-top or left-bottom
        anti=(c==right and r<n//2) or (c==left and r>=n//2)
        colors['anti' if anti else 'main']=v
    # interior square bounding frame
    rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if 5 in row]
    cols=[c for c in range(len(g[0])) if any(g[r][c]==5 for r in range(n))]
    for r in range(rows[0]+1,rows[-1]):
        for c in range(cols[0]+1,cols[-1]):
            g[r][c]=colors['main'] if (r-rows[0]-1)//2 == (c-cols[0]-1)//2 else colors['anti']
    return g
